scope: Two independent Direct engines on macOS; Linux/Android comparisons remain single CPU. No iPhone or dual-CPU Linux performance claim.
measurement: Paired CLI/GCD and reversed Android order, four measurements per option. Phase memory uses 100 ms sampling plus boundaries: arithmetic mean, sampled peak and latest. Short parallel phase has boundary samples only; its instantaneous footprint peak is not captured. Thread CPU and wall overlap cover private memory computation plus first compilation.

earlier_failure.result: ART internal 90-second deadline; hot branch exits repeatedly interrupt the host exclusive monitor

rejected_revision.result: Single-page prescan passed eight Android runs but increased fallback frequency and runtime; removed
